PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary fat_loss:
    name "Reduce body fat and improve insulin sensitivity"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Build aerobic base for glucose disposal"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Preserve lean mass via resistance training"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          leg_swings 1m
          cat_cow 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Zone 2 Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 25m
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          quad_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
          arm_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          lat_stretch 1m

      DAY Thursday training 35m "Brisk Walk Intervals":

          walking 5m

          walking 25m

          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength C":

          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 seconds rest 45 seconds

          chest_stretch 1m

      DAY Saturday training 40m "Steady State Cardio":
